title: 添加 rust-index 对 Python 语言的支持
description: 同一个 ZAgenticLoop 完成 rust-index Python 支持：纳入已完成基础 calls 工作，继续补齐 import dependency 召回、Python 基础符号语义与最终验证。

1.label: 添加 rust-index 对 Python 语言的支持

decisions.answer: 在同一个分支、同一个完整 ZAgenticLoop 中完成目标；不拆成多个 loop。已完成的 Rust Python call refs 提交纳入历史事实，继续补齐 import dependency recall、变量节点、最终验证与 closeout。
decisions.note: 用户明确要求一次对清楚 roadmap，用一个完整 loop 完成工作，以便测试 ZAgenticLoop。

1-1.label: 纳入已完成 Rust Python call refs 基线

1-2.label: 补齐 Rust Python import dependency recall

1-2-1.label: 锁定 Python from-import 每名称引用契约
1-2-1.notes: Commit intent: test: lock rust python from-import reference contract. Gate passed: cargo test --package zcodegraph-core indexes_minimal_python_symbols_and_imports; cargo fmt --check; git diff --check. Result: Rust Python now keeps module-level import refs and also emits per-name refs for helper/widget/T/sibling while skipping wildcard.

1-2-2.label: 补齐 Python 模块变量节点供 import 召回
1-2-2.notes: Commit intent: feat: index rust python module variables. Gate passed: cargo test --package zcodegraph-core indexes_minimal_python_symbols_and_imports; cargo fmt --check; git diff --check. Result: Rust Python now indexes simple top-level assignment identifiers such as widget as variable nodes, enabling from-import value recall.

1-2-3.label: 验证 rust-hybrid Python import 文件依赖召回
1-2-3.notes: Commit intent: test: verify rust python import dependency recall. Gate passed: npx vitest run __tests__/rust-index-engine-cli-language-smoke.test.ts -t indexes Python as Rust-owned; cargo test --package zcodegraph-core indexes_minimal_python_symbols_and_imports; cargo fmt --check; git diff --check. Result: rust-hybrid Python smoke proves pkg/foo.py dependents include pkg/bar.py for imported value/function usage.

1-3.label: 完成 Rust Python 支持全量验证与 closeout
